name: movement-lang
description: The data-movement language: parser, checker, and lowering for movements

scripts.harvest:programs: T=$(mktemp -d) && for c in v1 v2 current; do HARVEST_CORPUS=$c HARVEST_OUT=$T/$c.jsonl node ../../apps/api/node_modules/jest/bin/jest.js --config parser/harvest/jest.harvest.cjs || exit 1; done && node parser/harvest/build_fixture.cjs v1=$T/v1.jsonl v2=$T/v2.jsonl current=$T/current.jsonl
scripts.harvest:slots: T=$(mktemp -d) && for c in v1 v2 current; do HARVEST_CORPUS=$c HARVEST_OUT=$T/$c.jsonl node ../../apps/api/node_modules/jest/bin/jest.js --config parser/expression/harvest/jest.harvest.cjs || exit 1; done && node parser/expression/harvest/build_fixture.cjs v1=$T/v1.jsonl v2=$T/v2.jsonl current=$T/current.jsonl
scripts.harvest:checks: T=$(mktemp -d) && for c in v1 v2 current; do HARVEST_CORPUS=$c HARVEST_OUT=$T/$c.jsonl node ../../apps/api/node_modules/jest/bin/jest.js --config checker/harvest/jest.harvest.cjs || exit 1; done && node checker/harvest/build_fixture.cjs v1=$T/v1.jsonl v2=$T/v2.jsonl current=$T/current.jsonl
